successors.name: Pagaruyung Kingdom
successors.text: Dharmasraya and the Minangkabau highlands, where Adityawarman proclaimed himself king in Malayapura in 1347

successors.name: Majapahit
successors.text: Jambi-Melayu as one of the Sumatran lands the Majapahit dossier carries as a vassal sphere from 1352

ledger.x: 671: the kingdom of Malayu is first named, by the monk Yijing.
1028: Melayu-Jambi stands apart from Palembang again.
1347: Adityawarman takes Melayu from the Majapahit queen and makes it his own.

wars.name: Pamalayu expedition
wars.outcome: 'The expedition arguably established Javanese domination over Melayu and trade in the Strait of Malacca'; Mahesa Anabrang 'conquered Palembang and Jambi (Malayu)' in 1288, an alliance by marriage with two Malay princesses sent to Java, and the force 'returned…

wars.name: Malayu invasion of Java (Anjukladang inscription)
wars.outcome: The Anjukladang inscription of 937 'refers to repelling invading forces from Malayu'; no territorial result.

certainty.note: Inscriptions and Chinese reports name the kingdom and its seat but no frontier; every outline is a disc on a river valley.
